en: Operation begins, all aircraft enter!
Tactical Air Support Aircraft - Do Dai Kai
From "Mobile Suit Z Gundam", the sub-flight system operated by the anti-Earth Federation organization AEG, etc.
Do Dai Kai is commercialized in the 1/144 Scale HG series, which is perfect for collection.
Can be equipped with the 1/144 Scale MS (sold separately) that appeared in the play.
Recommended kit)
・HG 1/144 Hyakushiki (general store sales item)
・HG 1/144 Digier (general store sales item)
・HG 1/144 Rick Diaz (Quattro Vagina color) (General over-the-counter sales item)
・HG 1/144 Gundam Mk-II (AEGO specification) (general store sales item)
・HG 1/144 MSA-003 Nemo (general store sales item)
・HG 1/144 Zeta Gundam (general over-the-counter sales item)
・HG 1/144 RGM-86R Jim III (general over-the-counter sales item)
・HG 1/144 Jim II (AEGO color Ver.) (Premium Bandai sales item)
・HG 1/144 Gundam Base Limited Hyakushiki [Gold Coating] (Premium Bandai sales item)
etc.
*Some MSs (sold separately) may not be able to be installed due to their shape.
● Thoroughly reproduce the characteristic aircraft shape with completely new modeling!
Precisely expresses the details of various parts that make you feel like an aircraft.
● Reproduce the mobile suit boarding scene!
Handle grip and landing gear are included.
It is possible to reproduce the storage of the handle, the reproduction of the drawer, and the landing state of the gear by replacing it.
The footrest is movable, allowing it to flexibly accommodate the size and shape of the MS (sold separately) and action poses.
*This product does not include the MS body.
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
